vistas_materializadas.sql: SELECT u.id, u.username, COUNT(mc.id) as mechanics_completed, AVG(mc.score) as avg_score, SUM(mc.time_spent) as total_time FROM users u LEFT JOIN mechanic_completions mc ON u.id = mc.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.username

SELECT m.id, m.name, COUNT(DISTINCT mc.user_id) as unique_users, AVG(mc.score) as avg_score, COUNT(mc.id) as total_completions FROM modules m LEFT JOIN mechanic_completions mc ON m.id = mc.module_id GROUP BY m.id, m.name
